title: 五行山下
subtitle: 悟空学会安静等待
origin: 《西游记》第七回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 真正的成长不只在于本领更大，也在于愿意安静反思、守住约定并替别人着想。
moral.en: Growing wiser means more than gaining power; it also means reflecting calmly, keeping promises, and caring about others.

pages.en: After the commotion in Heaven settled, a wise guide invited Wukong to try a different challenge: quietness and patience.
